newsitem.title: NIGERIA: SOCCER-JULIUS BERGER WIN NIGERIAN F.A. CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JULIUS BERGER WIN NIGERIAN F.A. CUP.

text.p: Lagos side Julius Berger won the Nigerian F.A. Cup on Saturday when they scored a 'golden goal' in extra-time to beat northern side Katsina United.
Taiwo Oloyede scored the goal from a free-kick in the seventh minute of extra-time to secure Julius Berger's place in the African Cup Winners' Cup.
League winners Udoji United, from eastern Onitsha town, will represent Nigeria in next year's African Champions' Cup, while runners-up Jasper United, also from Onitsha, will play in the CAF Cup.
